## Answers

**h01 — S3 presign refresher**
`s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`, entry `RunOnce`→`CheckAndPresign` at :43/:47) re-presigns S3-backed attachment URLs (skips any whose presign is younger than 4 days of a 5-day expiry, :85-91) — **schedule: once immediately at startup, then every 12 h** (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, :27; ticker loop :29-41) — **wiring: `server.startBackgroundRunners`, `server/server.go:162-171`** (immediate `RunOnce` at :163, goroutine `Run` at :169), called from `Server.Start` (`server/server.go:129`).

**h02 — Webhook delivery + SSRF guard**
- Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`; the actual request is `safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`. (`PostAsync`, :184, only enqueues; 4 init-time workers call `Post`, :42-55.)
- Protection: dial-time IP blocking — `safeDialContext` resolves the host and rejects reserved ranges (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`), using `isReservedIP`/`reservedCIDRs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54`, covers loopback, RFC-1918, 169.254.0.0/16 IMDS, IPv6 equivalents); this also defeats DNS rebinding. Configuration-time check: `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`) called from `server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74,161,182`. Escape hatch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:41`) set from `--allow-private-webhooks` (`cmd/memos/main.go:49`).

**h03 — Identity providers**
- Abstraction package: `internal/idp` — but note it is *not* a Go interface; it defines only the shared result type `idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3-8`), and dispatch is an explicit type switch on `storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2` (`server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:120-121`).
- Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` — `oauth2.IdentityProvider` with `ExchangeToken` and `UserInfo` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20,47,83`). OAuth2 is the only protocol shipped.

**h04 — MySQL driver construction**
**No.** `mysql.NewDB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`) has exactly one caller in the graph — `db.NewDBDriver` (`store/db/db.go:14`, call at `store/db/db.go:22`) — and a whole-repo text search for `mysql.NewDB` / imports of `store/db/mysql` returns only `store/db/db.go:8,22`. Tests also go through the factory (`store/test/store.go:28,50`); the only other MySQL-specific helper is `test.GetMySQLDSN` (`store/test/containers.go:90`), which builds a DSN, not a driver.

**h05 — Reactions on user delete**
**Mechanism: explicit Go code inside the driver's delete transaction — not a DB cascade.**
- Explicit deletes: `deleteUserTargetsTx` calls `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` then `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (`store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102`; declarations at :380,:400). Same pair per dialect: `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:417,437`, `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:380,400`. Entry: `store.Store.DeleteUser` → `driver.DeleteUser` (`store/user.go:171-172`, `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:29`), reached from `APIV1Service.DeleteUser` (`server/router/api/v1/user_service.go:414`).
- Absence of a DB rule: the `reaction` table has no FK/cascade (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:91-98`, mysql/postgres LATEST.sql:91-98); the only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in any schema is `memo_share.memo_id` (`store/migration/{sqlite:109,mysql:108,postgres:108}/LATEST.sql`), and SQLite is opened with `foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`).

**h06 — RPC handlers reaching an outbound HTTP call to a user-configured URL**
Handlers (all `APIV1Service`, also exposed via `ConnectServiceHandler`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` (dispatch at :157)
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`, :513 → `memo_update_helpers.go:67`)
- `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` (dispatch at :562)
- `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` (→ `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:30`)
- also `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:48`) and `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:48`) via the same side-effect helper.

Convergence: all paths funnel through `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`) into the single delivery function **`webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`** (HTTP issued at :152).

**h07 — Serving another user's avatar**
```
GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar (route)      — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124
FileServerService.serveUserAvatar               — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168
  (anonymous gate: Profile.AllowAnonymous / getCurrentUser — fileserver.go:173-181, :708)
FileServerService.getUserByUsername             — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
store.Store.GetUser (user cache check)          — store/user.go:148-156
store.Store.ListUsers                           — store/user.go:136
store.Driver.ListUsers (interface)              — store/driver.go
sqlite.DB.ListUsers (default driver) → SELECT … avatar_url FROM user — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88, :151-161
```
The bytes come back as a base64 data URI in `user.avatar_url`, parsed by `parseDataURI` and MIME-checked against `avatarAllowedTypes` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:196-203`, :75).

**h08 — `RunOnce` declarers**
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked**: certified zero callers in the graph (`[ArchMap query]` returned a certified zero), and text search finds no `memopayload.NewRunner` outside the package (only `RebuildMemoPayload` is used, from `memo_service.go:108,447`). Effectively dead in production.
- `s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked**: callers `s3presign.Runner.Run` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`) and `server.Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:163`).

**h09 — `Close` declarations**
Count: **8 declarations in non-test backend code** (6 concrete + 2 interface), plus 2 test-helper declarations (`store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282`) = 10 total.
- `v1.SSEHub.Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99` — **called** by `Server.closeLongLivedConnections`, `server/server.go:206`
- `store.Store.Close` — `store/store.go:72` — **called** by `Server.Shutdown`, `server/server.go:146`
- `cache.Cache.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187` — **called** by `store.Store.Close`, `store/store.go:74-76` (three caches)
- `store.Driver.Close` (interface) — `store/driver.go:12` — **called** at `store/store.go:78`, dispatching to `sqlite.DB.Close` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`) by default, or `mysql.DB.Close` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`) / `postgres.DB.Close` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`)
- `cache.Interface.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:31` — interface declaration; the concrete `*cache.Cache` is used directly.

**h10 — Highest fan-in under `internal/`**
`filter.renderer.addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — **≈28 inbound call edges** (from 14 distinct caller functions, all within `internal/filter/render.go`). Runner-up: `filter.Schema.Field` (`internal/filter/schema.go:67`, ~19).

**h11 — Data-layer entity with widest external reach**
1st: **`store.User`** (`store/user.go:29`) — 85 inbound edges spanning ~6 packages outside `store/`: `server/router/api/v1`, `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`, plus test helpers.
2nd: **`store.Memo`** (`store/memo.go:35`) — 57 inbound edges across ~4 external packages: `server/router/api/v1`, `server/notification`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`.
(`store.Attachment`, `store/attachment.go:16`, has more raw edges — 64 — but concentrates in only 2 external packages: `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/api/v1`.)

**h12 — Which INSERT runs for a memo on a default install**
Concrete method: **`sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`** (statement built at :41, `INSERT INTO \`memo\` (…) RETURNING …`).
Determination: the driver flag defaults to `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` viper default, :130 flag default), the factory `db.NewDBDriver` switches on `profile.Driver` and returns `sqlite.NewDB` for that value (`store/db/db.go:18-20`, `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:24`), and `store.Store.CreateMemo` is a thin delegate to `s.driver.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109-113`) over the `store.Driver` interface (`store/driver.go:29`), whose other implementors are `mysql.DB.CreateMemo` (`store/db/mysql/memo.go:16`) and `postgres.DB.CreateMemo` (`store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`).

**h13 — Markdown interface dispatch**
- Impl: a single unexported concrete type `markdown.service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`), implementing all 8 methods of `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`); no other implementor exists.
- Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`) — production call site `NewAPIV1Service` with `WithTagExtension()` + `WithMentionExtension()` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`); test-only second site `test.NewTestService` (`server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:24`).
- Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected at `server/server.go:85`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), and the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(_, memo, markdownService)` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).

**h14 — Derived memo metadata**
- Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`), which calls `markdown.service.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-420`) and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
- Triggers: memo creation — `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (before `Store.CreateMemo` at :115); memo content update — `APIV1Service.UpdateMemo` when the `content` mask path is present, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (payload written at :451); bulk backfill — `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce`, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52` (declared but not wired into startup, see h08).
- Extracted properties: deduplicated `#tags` (`markdown.go:376-378,417`) and `MemoPayload_Property`: `Title` from a leading H1, `HasLink`, `HasCode` (code block/fenced/inline), `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (`markdown.go:383-405`). Mentions are also extracted (`markdown.go:379-381`) and used for notifications (`server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32`). Separately, the list/preview `snippet` is derived on read via `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:85`, used at `memo_service_converter.go:76-80`) and is not persisted.

**h15 — Visibility enforcement sites**
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo reads) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67`
- List-query filter injection (`visibility == "PUBLIC"` / `creator_id == N || visibility in [...]`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:222`; `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:184-186`; `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:158-160`; `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:109-111`
- File server attachment access check — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677` (public + anonymous allowed) and `:699` (private → 403), plus avatar's anonymous gate at `:173-181`
- SSE fan-out filter `SSEClient.canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-144`
- Reactions — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:38` and `:83`
- Comment creation — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- Attachment service access — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-451`; memo-attachment listing — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:222`
- RSS feeds restricted to `store.Public` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Mention-notification suppression for private memos — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62,67`; email notification gate — `server/notification/email.go:313-316`

**r01 — Premise wrong: there is no Redis and no Redis-configurable TTL.**
A repo-wide search for `redis` matches 0 of 1042 files. Caching is an in-process, in-memory `sync.Map`-based cache: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache`, `New`, TTL sweep `cleanupLoop` at :200). The store creates three of them — instance settings, users, user settings — with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, `CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute`, `MaxItems: 1000` (`store/store.go:40-53`). So **user entries live 10 minutes**, keyed by `userCacheKey(user.ID)` (`store/user.go:132,143,150`), and are invalidated on delete (`store/user.go:179`). Caches are shut down in `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:74-76`).

**r02 — Premise wrong: there is no rate-limiting middleware, per-user or otherwise.**
No matches for `RateLimit|rate.Limit|ratelimit|golang.org/x/time/rate|Throttle` across 343 Go files, none for `limiter|StatusTooManyRequests`, and `[ArchMap query]` is a certified miss across 7293 symbols. The Echo middleware stack is only `Recover()` + CORS (`server/server.go:51-52`). The only request-throttling constructs are concurrency semaphores: `thumbnailSemaphore` (3) and `imageProcessingSemaphore` (2) in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:59-60`, and `fileserver`'s `thumbnailSemaphore` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:116`).

**r03 — Premise wrong: there is no cron scheduler running any job, so no nightly cleanup time exists.**
`internal/scheduler` exists (cron-expression parser, middleware, `Scheduler.Register/Start`, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go:54,70,91`) but `scheduler.New` has **zero non-test callers** — every reference is in `internal/scheduler/{doc,example_test,integration_test}.go`; the graph returns a certified zero for its callers. The only background scheduling in the server is the plain 12-hour `time.Ticker` of the S3 presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41`, wired at `server/server.go:162-171`). No cleanup/vacuum job is registered anywhere.

**r04 — Premise wrong: no message broker at all (neither NATS nor RabbitMQ), and no queue is declared in any broker.**
Zero matches for `nats.|rabbitmq|amqp` across 1042 files. Webhook delivery uses an **in-process buffered Go channel**: `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`), drained by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`) that call `Post` (:120). Enqueue is non-blocking and **drops** on overflow (`PostAsync`, :184-196) — no persistence, no retries, no cross-process queue.

**r05 — Premise wrong: there is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL server.**
Zero matches for `graphql|GraphQL|gqlgen` across 343 Go files. The public surface is **protobuf-defined gRPC/Connect + grpc-gateway REST**: 74 generated `/api/v1/...` gateway routes (e.g. `GET /api/v1/memos`, `POST /api/v1/memos`, `PATCH /api/v1/{memo.name=memos/*}` in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go:1745`; user routes in `user_service.pb.gw.go:2301`), registered by `apiV1Service.RegisterGateway` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64`, `server/server.go:88`). Contracts live in `proto/` with generated Go in `proto/gen/api/v1` and a Connect layer in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect`. Non-gateway HTTP doors: `GET /api/v1/sse` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:25`), `/file/attachments/:uid/:filename` and `/file/users/:identifier/avatar` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:123-124`), RSS `/explore/rss.xml`, `/u/:username/rss.xml` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:72,111`), `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:128,143`), `/healthz` (`server/server.go:67`), plus an MCP service driven by the generated OpenAPI spec (`server/router/mcp/`, `proto/gen/openapi.yaml`).
